winner_details.name: 16-bit Carry Look-Ahead Adder (Hierarchical 4x4)
advantages: Fastest single-cycle addition (0.88 ns, 1.13 GHz theoretical)
77.5% faster than baseline RCA
Lowest Area-Delay Product (421.7 µm²·ns)
drawbacks: High fan-out carry generator cells (AOI/OA gates) increase wire capacitive loading

cska_recommended_partition.name: Uniform 4x4 (Baseline)
cska_recommended_partition.recommendation: Optimal general-purpose choice for 16-bit words. Perfect balance of bypass MUX count and local ripple delay.

engineering_rationale: The Carry Look-Ahead Adder (CLA) won the selection (76.03/100) due to its sub-nanosecond propagation delay (0.88 ns), delivering theoretical fmax of 1.13 GHz.
Its 8.8% area overhead (479.2 µm²) and 29% power increase are fully justified under high-throughput design constraints.

all_rankings.name: 16-bit Carry Look-Ahead Adder (Hierarchical 4x4)

all_rankings.name: 16-bit Carry Skip Adder (Uniform 4x4)
advantages: Optimal balance between latency and silicon overhead
Zero area penalty vs RCA in Sky130 technology mapping
57.1% latency reduction over RCA with identical cell count
Extremely low dynamic switching power in skip multiplexers
Regular, abuttable physical layout structure
drawbacks: Slower than full tree adders (CLA/BK) for extreme frequency targets

all_rankings.name: 16-bit Ripple Carry Adder
advantages: Absolute minimal routing wirelength and congestion
Simplest possible RTL and standard-cell layout
Lowest static and dynamic power consumption
drawbacks: Severe linear delay growth O(N) = 3.92 ns
Unsuitable for high-speed clock domains (> 250 MHz)

all_rankings.name: 16-bit Carry Select Adder (Speculative Dual-Chain)
advantages: Fast speculative carry selection (1.54 ns)
60.7% speed improvement over RCA
Very simple multiplexer selection topology
drawbacks: 33.3% higher dynamic switching power due to redundant speculative dual carry paths
High multiplexer routing fanout across bit boundaries

all_rankings.name: 16-bit Brent-Kung Parallel Prefix Adder
advantages: Low logic depth with regular tree structure
69.9% faster than RCA (1.18 ns)
Predictable logarithmic delay scaling O(log2 N)
drawbacks: Highest cell count (77 cells) and highest area (506.7 µm²)
Complex prefix routing tree creates metal track congestion
